newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PRESS DIGEST - Pakistani newspapers - August 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Pakistani newspapers - August 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Pakistani press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- India has allowed Pakistan to establish transit trade with land-locked Nepal through Indian ports.
- The government has offered for sale management and the 19.60 million shares it holds of Schon Bank Ltd.
- Local blenders have decided to buy about one million kg of tea from India.
- The shipping lines of the Europe Pakistan India Consortium have announced that their ships will call at Qasim International Container Terminal in Karachi effective September 7.
- India's missile programme will eventually trigger a missile race in South Asia, Pakistan's foreign office said.
- United Nations and Pakistan working for peace in Afghanistan will continue their diplomatic efforts by holding talks with warring factons in the next few days.
- An Army court has rejected a request by Major General Zaheerul Islam, being tried on charges of treason, to tranfer his case to the Supreme Court.
- President Farooq Leghari called for greater involvement of private sector in the development of a port at Gawadar.
